# Hair by Alora

> Blonde, balayage and lived-in colour specialist inside Aura Hair Collective, Carey Bay, Lake Macquarie NSW. Owner-operator Alora.

## Booking
- Book online: https://laydbackapps.com/sites/hair-by-alora/book/
- Live availability with real durations and AUD prices. 48 hours notice to change or cancel.
